E4_exactness_certificate_expanded.diagnostics_summary: Of the 95 canonical queries, 92 queries have >= 5 reachable paths and all 92 (100.0%) achieve exactness certification at B >= 7. The remaining 3 queries (['phoenix', 'confucius', 'streetlights']) physically possess fewer than 5 paths in their accessible subgraphs; for all 3, the frontier empties completely, proving exhaustive retrieval of all available paths.

E5_budget_depth_bounds_with_s.formula_note: L_max^wc = floor( log_Delta( 1 + B*(Delta - 1)/(s*Delta) ) ), k_max = L_max + 1.

E6_approximate_search_tradeoff.narrative: Less computation corresponds to small controlled retrieval loss. Recall@5 increases monotonically from 69.4% to 94.2% while Best-score gap drops from 0.0605 to 0.0000.

E7_proxy_monotone_noisy_or_bounds.terminology_note: Proxy possible-world analysis with strictly monotone link mapping p_u = g(mu_u). In alignment with reviewer recommendations, all wording explicitly uses 'proxy monotone mapping' rather than 'calibrated mapping' because g(mu) preserves ordering and algebraic monotonicity (g'(mu) > 0) without empirical Platt/isotonic calibration on audited labels.

E8_interval_refinement_30facts.narrative: More computation directly yields tighter uncertainty intervals. Invariant W_{k+1} <= W_k holds strictly with 0 violations across all 30 facts.
